_note: Result-screen encouragement (docs/learning-loop-design.md item 4). Edit freely: praise effort, strategy and persistence; name a next step; never compare with other children; never 'smart', 'genius' or 'talented'; 'not yet' instead of 'fail'. Bands: perfect = every answer right, high = 80% and over, mid = 50-79%, low = under 50%. use 'tier' = shown after tier quizzes only; 'all' = tier quizzes, Daily Review and papers. Keep at least one 'all' line per band. Chinese-subject results show zh with en underneath until bilingualUntil (inclusive, local date), then zh only.

perfect.en: Every answer correct. The way you prepared worked, so keep doing it.
perfect.zh: 全部答对！你的准备方法很有效，继续保持。

perfect.en: Full marks! You read each question carefully, and it showed.
perfect.zh: 满分！你认真读了每一道题，成果看得见。

perfect.en: All correct. Try the next tier or a new topic to keep stretching.
perfect.zh: 全对了。试试下一级或新的课题，继续挑战自己。

perfect.en: A perfect round. Which questions feel easy now that used to feel hard?
perfect.zh: 完美的一轮！哪些题以前觉得难，现在觉得容易了？

perfect.en: You checked your work, and it paid off. All correct!
perfect.zh: 你仔细检查了答案，努力有了回报。全部正确！

high.en: Strong work. The questions you missed show exactly what to practise next.
high.zh: 做得很好！答错的题，正好告诉你下一步练什么。

high.en: Nearly all correct. Your careful working is making a difference.
high.zh: 几乎全对。你认真作答，效果很明显。

high.en: Great effort. The ones you missed come back as retests, so you get another go.
high.zh: 很努力！答错的题会再出现，你还有机会再试。

high.en: You stayed focused to the end. Sort out the last few and you have it.
high.zh: 你一直专心到最后。弄懂最后几题，你就掌握了。

high.en: Well done for sticking with the harder questions. Check the steps for the ones you missed.
high.zh: 难题你也坚持做完了，很棒。看看答错题的讲解吧。

mid.en: Good progress. Every mistake here is a clue about what to practise.
mid.zh: 有进步！每一个错误都是线索，告诉你该练什么。

mid.en: At least half right. Read the worked steps for the rest, then try again tomorrow.
mid.zh: 至少答对了一半。读一读其余题目的讲解，明天再试。

mid.en: Keep going. Mistakes are how you learn, and the missed ones come back as retests.
mid.zh: 继续加油！犯错是学习的一部分，答错的题会再出现。

mid.en: Nice effort. Next time, try one new strategy: underline the key words first.
mid.zh: 很努力！下次试一个新方法：先圈出题目里的关键词。

mid.en: You are building this skill step by step. Go through the missed questions slowly.
mid.zh: 你正在一步一步地进步。慢慢看一遍答错的题目吧。

low.en: Not yet, and that's fine. Every try teaches you something.
low.zh: 还没掌握，没关系。每一次尝试都有收获。

low.en: Hard questions are how you grow. Start with the worked steps.
low.zh: 难题能帮助你成长。先看看每一步的讲解。

low.en: Thanks for sticking with it. Try the tier below or your review first, then come back.
low.zh: 谢谢你坚持做完！可以先做低一级或复习，再回来挑战。

low.en: Pick one missed question and work through it step by step.
low.zh: 选一道答错的题，一步一步地把它弄懂。

low.en: Today showed you what to practise. The missed questions come back so you can try again.
low.zh: 今天你知道了该练什么。答错的题会再出现，让你再试一次。
